data.name: Nathan
data.title: Son of David
data.description: A son of King David through whom the biological lineage of Jesus is traced in Luke's Gospel.
data.scripture_text: Nathan was the son of David.

data.name: Mattatha
data.title: Son of Nathan
data.description: The son of Nathan and a grandson of King David.
data.scripture_text: Mattatha was the son of Nathan.

data.name: Menna
data.title: Son of Mattatha
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the biological line recorded by Luke.
data.scripture_text: Menna was the son of Mattatha.

data.name: Melea
data.title: Son of Menna
data.description: A descendant of David in the lineage leading to Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Melea was the son of Menna.

data.name: Eliakim
data.title: Son of Melea
data.description: A member of the Davidic line through Nathan, distinct from the Eliakim in Matthew's royal line.
data.scripture_text: Eliakim was the son of Melea.

data.name: Jonam
data.title: Son of Eliakim
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the pre-exilic period of the Davidic lineage.
data.scripture_text: Jonam was the son of Eliakim.

data.name: Joseph
data.title: Son of Jonam
data.description: A descendant of David through Nathan, not to be confused with Joseph the husband of Mary.
data.scripture_text: Joseph was the son of Jonam.

data.name: Judah
data.title: Son of Joseph
data.description: A member of the biological lineage of Jesus Christ as recorded in Luke.
data.scripture_text: Judah was the son of Joseph.

data.name: Simeon
data.title: Son of Judah
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the line of Nathan.
data.scripture_text: Simeon was the son of Judah.

data.name: Levi
data.title: Son of Simeon
data.description: A member of the Davidic lineage, named after the forefather of the priestly tribe.
data.scripture_text: Levi was the son of Simeon.

data.name: Matthat
data.title: Son of Levi
data.description: An ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus, the first of two by this name in Luke's list.
data.scripture_text: Jorim was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi.

data.name: Jorim
data.title: Son of Matthat
data.description: A descendant of Nathan and David in the lineage of Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Jorim was the son of Matthat.

data.name: Eliezer
data.title: Son of Jorim
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus mentioned in the biological genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Eliezer was the son of Jorim.

data.name: Joshua
data.title: Son of Eliezer
data.description: A member of the Davidic line through Nathan, bearing the name of the great leader of Israel.
data.scripture_text: Joshua was the son of Eliezer.

data.name: Er
data.title: Son of Joshua
data.description: An ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded by Luke.
data.scripture_text: Er was the son of Joshua.

data.name: Elmadam
data.title: Son of Er
data.description: A descendant of David in the lineage leading to Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Cosam was the son of Elmadam. Elmadam was the son of Er.

data.name: Cosam
data.title: Son of Elmadam
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus mentioned in the biological record of Luke.
data.scripture_text: Cosam was the son of Elmadam.

data.name: Addi
data.title: Son of Cosam
data.description: A member of the lineage of David through Nathan.
data.scripture_text: Addi was the son of Cosam.

data.name: Melki
data.title: Son of Addi
data.description: The first of two ancestors named Melki in Luke's genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Melki was the son of Addi.

data.name: Neri
data.title: Son of Melki
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus and the father of Shealtiel in the biological line.
data.scripture_text: Shealtiel was the son of Neri. Neri was the son of Melki.

data.name: Shealtiel
data.title: Son of Neri
data.description: A key figure in the lineage who connected the line of Nathan to the line that would produce Zerubbabel.
data.scripture_text: Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the son of Neri.

data.name: Zerubbabel
data.title: Son of Shealtiel
data.description: The leader of the return from Babylon, appearing in both genealogies of Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel. Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.

data.name: Rhesa
data.title: Son of Zerubbabel
data.description: The son of Zerubbabel and an ancestor of Jesus in the post-exilic period.
data.scripture_text: Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel.

data.name: Joanan
data.title: Son of Rhesa
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the biological genealogy recorded by Luke.
data.scripture_text: Joanan was the son of Rhesa.

data.name: Joda
data.title: Son of Joanan
data.description: A member of the Davidic line leading to Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Josech was the son of Joda. Joda was the son of Joanan.

data.name: Josech
data.title: Son of Joda
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Nathan.
data.scripture_text: Josech was the son of Joda.

data.name: Semein
data.title: Son of Josech
data.description: A descendant of David in the genealogy of Jesus Christ.
data.scripture_text: Mattathias was the son of Semein. Semein was the son of Josech.

data.name: Mattathias
data.title: Son of Semein
data.description: The first of two ancestors named Mattathias in this section of the genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Maath was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Semein.

data.name: Maath
data.title: Son of Mattathias
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus mentioned in the Gospel of Luke.
data.scripture_text: Maath was the son of Mattathias.

data.name: Naggai
data.title: Son of Maath
data.description: A member of the lineage of Jesus Christ in the post-exilic period.
data.scripture_text: Esli was the son of Naggai. Naggai was the son of Maath.

data.name: Esli
data.title: Son of Naggai
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the Davidic line through Nathan.
data.scripture_text: Esli was the son of Naggai.

data.name: Nahum
data.title: Son of Esli
data.description: A descendant of David in the genealogy recorded by Luke.
data.scripture_text: Amos was the son of Nahum. Nahum was the son of Esli.

data.name: Amos
data.title: Son of Nahum
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus Christ, not to be confused with the prophet Amos.
data.scripture_text: Amos was the son of Nahum.

data.name: Mattathias
data.title: Son of Amos
data.description: The second ancestor named Mattathias in Luke's genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Joseph was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Amos.

data.name: Joseph
data.title: Son of Mattathias
data.description: Another ancestor named Joseph in the lineage between David and the Messiah.
data.scripture_text: Jannai was the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Mattathias.

data.name: Jannai
data.title: Son of Joseph
data.description: A member of the pre-Messianic lineage of Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Melki was the son of Jannai. Jannai was the son of Joseph.

data.name: Melki
data.title: Son of Jannai
data.description: The second ancestor named Melki in Luke's list, appearing late in the genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Levi was the son of Melki. Melki was the son of Jannai.

data.name: Levi
data.title: Son of Melki
data.description: The second ancestor named Levi in the lineage recorded by Luke.
data.scripture_text: Matthat was the son of Levi. Levi was the son of Melki.

data.name: Matthat
data.title: Son of Levi
data.description: The father of Heli and grandfather of Joseph in the biological lineage of Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Heli was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi.

data.name: Heli
data.title: Father of Joseph
data.description: The father of Joseph (often understood as Mary's father, making him Joseph's father-in-law) in Luke's genealogy.
data.scripture_text: Joseph was the son of Heli.

data.name: Joseph
data.title: Husband of Mary
data.description: The legal father of Jesus, whose biological connection to David is traced through the line of Nathan in Luke's Gospel.
data.scripture_text: Jesus was known as the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Heli.

data.name: Jesus
data.title: The Son of God
data.description: The Messiah and Savior, whose earthly lineage is traced through Nathan back to David and Adam in Luke's Gospel.
data.scripture_text: Jesus was about thirty years old when he began his public ministry.
